a.lede: An NAACP lawsuit accuses the SpaceX-owned AI company of violating the Clean Air Act.
a.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward

b.lede: SpaceX loses latest legal fight over xAI's gas-powered data centers in Mississippi — court rejects arguments that mobile turbines are exempt from air permits
b.title: SpaceX loses bid to dismiss lawsuit over xAI data center pollution
